newsitem.title: UK: UK Parliament's Treasury Committee named.
newsitem.headline: UK Parliament's Treasury Committee named.

text.p: Seven Labour MPs, four Conservatives and a Liberal Democrat will form the Treasury Committee in the new British parliament, the parliamentary order paper for Tuesday showed.

It named the members of the freshly-selected committee as Liz Blackman (Labour), Malcolm Bruce (Liberal Democrat treasury spokesman), Charles Clarke (Labour), Tony Colman (Labour), Jim Cousins (Labour), Quentin Davies (Conservative), Ruth Kelly (Labour, former deputy head of the Inflation Report Division of the Bank of England), Sir Peter Llloyd (Conservative), Giles Radice (Labour), Brian Sedgemore (Labour), Sir Michael Spicer (Conservative) and Sir Teddy Taylor (Conservative).
